title: Module cohomology is abelian cohomology
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, let $T$ be a scheme and write
$\mathrm{For}:\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)\to\Ab(T_{\Et})$ for the functor forgetting
the $\Lambda$-module structure.

1. If $I$ is an injective object of $\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$, then for every
   étale $U\to T$ one has $H^q(U_{\Et},\mathrm{For}\,I)=0$ for $q>0$.
2. For every sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules and every étale $U\to T$, the
   derived functors of $\Gamma(U,-)$ computed in $\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and
   in $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ agree: $\mathrm{For}\,H^q_{\Lambda}(U,F)\cong
   H^q(U,\mathrm{For}\,F)$ canonically.
3. For a morphism $u:S\to T$ and $F\in\Mod(S_{\Et},\Lambda)$ there are
   canonical isomorphisms $\mathrm{For}\,R^qu_*F\cong R^qu_*\mathrm{For}\,F$,
   and for $K\in D^+(S_{\Et},\Lambda)$ a canonical isomorphism
   $\mathrm{For}\,Ru_*K\cong Ru_*\mathrm{For}\,K$ in $D^+(T_{\Et},\mathbf Z)$.

The forgetful functor need not preserve injectives; only the acyclicity of
(1) is used.

proof.text: Use moduleSheaf_constantRing_equivalence to identify a ModuleCat-valued sheaf with a sheaf of modules over the constant ring sheaf, together with the specified underlying-abelian natural isomorphism. An equivalence preserves injectives, so an injective module-valued sheaf gives an injective sheaf of modules.

For any covering family choose its SiteCechComplex. Exact module sheafification gives injectivity of the underlying module presheaf. In degree q+1 the universe-compatible cocycle-lifting theorem gives a primitive for each cocycle. ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff, exactAt_iff and ExactAt.isZero_homology give zero homology. The etale SiteCechComplex comparison transports this to the categorical Cech complex.

Apply the etale Cech vanishing criterion with B all objects and Cov all covering families. Every intersection belongs to B and each covering refines itself by identities. The preceding step supplies positive Cech vanishing. Transport positive derived evaluation vanishing through the underlying-abelian isomorphism from step 1. Rewrite each positive q as n+1. This proves the first conjunct in the existing derived-evaluation convention without using a separate localization theorem.

Apply isIso_rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_of_rightAcyclic to moduleEvaluationForgetIso, with G and Gprime evaluation, beta moduleAbelianForget and gamma the ModuleCat-to-AddCommGrpCat forgetful functor. Step 3 supplies right acyclicity on forgotten injectives. The exactness instances for beta are already provided by ModuleAbelianDerivedDirectImageComparison; gamma preserves finite limits and colimits by Mathlib. Unfold moduleEvaluationForgetComparison and rightDerivedBaseChange: all factors are components or functor images of isomorphisms, giving the second conjunct, including q=0.

Use isIso_moduleAbelianDerivedLowerStarComparison for f:S to T. Unfolding moduleAbelianDerivedLowerStarComparison and rightDerivedBaseChange expresses the classical comparison as the degree-q homology image of this canonical D+ isomorphism at F[0], conjugated by single-object and exact-forgetting homology isomorphisms. Typeclass inference proves invertibility of every factor and hence the third conjunct. Evaluating the same D+ natural isomorphism at K gives the fourth conjunct. The specified canonical maps and all existing signatures remain unchanged.

lean.statement: theorem module_cohomology_conventions (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (T : Scheme.{u}) : (∀ (I : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) [Injective I] (U : T.Etale) (q : ℕ), 0 < q → IsZero (((sheafToPresheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙ (evaluation _ _).obj (op U)).rightDerived q).obj ((moduleAbelianForget Λ T).obj I))) ∧ (∀ (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (U : T.Etale) (q : ℕ), IsIso ((moduleEvaluationForgetComparison Λ T U q).app F)) ∧ (∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (f : S ⟶ T) (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ), IsIso ((Functor.rightDerivedBaseChange.{u + 1, u + 2, u + 1, u + 2, u + 1, u + 2, u + 1, u + 2, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (B := Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (B' := Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (C := Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (C' := Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (G := lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f) (G' := lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f) (β := moduleAbelianForget Λ S) (γ := moduleAbelianForget Λ T) (moduleAbelianLowerStarIso Λ f).hom q).app F)) ∧ (∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (f : S ⟶ T) (K : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))), IsIso ((moduleAbelianDerivedLowerStarComparison Λ f).app K))
